reclassification.statement: The six records are output of a synthetic generator, not measurements. They support no claim.

findings.statement: Both frame records (lines 3 and 6) give telemetry_source SYNTHETIC_LATTICE and evidence_status MEASURED.
All four action records set phase_lock_deg from 51.843 to 51.843. The recalibration cannot change the parameter, so it cannot reduce W_2, and it fires twice for each frame.

Lines 2 and 5 both chain from 64 zeros, so the file holds two separate chains, recorded at 2026-10-07T11:28:31Z and 11:35:02Z. Each holds one frame, and both frames are PCRB-TR-00000001 with frame_seq 1. Dormant and emerging come from separate one-frame runs; the file records no transition between them.

In both frames xi equals lambda_c * phi / gamma to within 3e-5, and lambda_c * phi / (gamma + 1e-6) to within 1e-5, inside the rounding of the six-decimal inputs. xi is computed from the other three values, not measured separately.
In each run the first action is chained before its frame but timestamped after it (line 2 after line 3, line 5 after line 6).
Line 1 is a '#' comment, so the file is not valid JSONL, and every record carries float timestamps, which OSIRIS-CANONICAL-JSON-V1 rejects. No line is a valid OSIRIS-TELEMETRY-V1 record.

limitations: entry_hash, prev_hash, receipt_hash and frame.digest were not recomputed: their hashing rule is not documented and the generator, which ran on Node Beta, is not in this repository. They are cited as written; each line is bound by its own SHA-256 instead.
The generator's source and configuration were not inspected. The findings rest on the ledger file alone.
